entries.title: Metal rod conduction chain
entries.description: A row of touching metal spheres on a light floor where one end sphere is suddenly heated to red and heat energy pulses along the chain, with color gradients, energy-flow arrows, and temperature labels over time.
entries.seed: Metal rod conduction chain: A row of touching metal spheres on a light floor where one end sphere is suddenly heated to red and heat energy pulses along the chain, with color gradients, energy-flow arrows, and temperature labels over time.

entries.title: Hot and cold water mixing tank
entries.description: A transparent cube tank half-filled with blue “cold” particles and injected with red “hot” particles from a pipe, where particles bounce, mix, and gradually shift color to purple as temperature equalizes, with a floating thermometer.
entries.seed: Hot and cold water mixing tank: A transparent cube tank half-filled with blue “cold” particles and injected with red “hot” particles from a pipe, where particles bounce, mix, and gradually shift color to purple as temperature equalizes, with a floating thermometer.

entries.title: Campfire heating surrounding air
entries.description: A flickering orange-red cone of flame built from small glowing particles that rise and fade, warming nearby air particles that speed up and change color from blue to yellow as they drift upward in convection currents.
entries.seed: Campfire heating surrounding air: A flickering orange-red cone of flame built from small glowing particles that rise and fade, warming nearby air particles that speed up and change color from blue to yellow as they drift upward in convection currents.

entries.title: Sun heating a rotating planet
entries.description: A bright sphere (Sun) radiating thin yellow rays to a slowly rotating Earth-like sphere, where the lit side warms and turns from cool blue to warm green/yellow, with temperature bands labeled around the planet.

entries.title: Thermal expansion of a metal bridge
entries.description: A long, segmented metallic beam spanning two supports that slowly heats from blue to red, expanding and pushing against sliding joints, with small arrows and numeric labels showing length change versus temperature.
entries.seed: Thermal expansion of a metal bridge: A long, segmented metallic beam spanning two supports that slowly heats from blue to red, expanding and pushing against sliding joints, with small arrows and numeric labels showing length change versus temperature.

entries.title: Piston–gas temperature and pressure demo
entries.description: A transparent cylinder containing bouncing gas particles under a movable piston; compressing the piston speeds and reddens particles (heating), while raising it slows and blues them (cooling), with live pressure and temperature meters.
entries.seed: Piston–gas temperature and pressure demo: A transparent cylinder containing bouncing gas particles under a movable piston; compressing the piston speeds and reddens particles (heating), while raising it slows and blues them (cooling), with live pressure and temperature meters.

entries.title: Ice cube melting on a hot plate
entries.description: A semi-transparent blue ice block sitting on a glowing orange plate where heat flows upward, the block shrinks and drips clear “water” droplets that spread on the plate, with a color bar showing surface temperature.
entries.seed: Ice cube melting on a hot plate: A semi-transparent blue ice block sitting on a glowing orange plate where heat flows upward, the block shrinks and drips clear “water” droplets that spread on the plate, with a color bar showing surface temperature.

entries.title: Infrared radiation from a hot object
entries.description: A red-hot metal cube in the center of a light room emitting thin semi-transparent purple rays that curve outward and fade, heating nearby small spheres that gradually shift color and display numeric temperature labels.

entries.title: Thermal conduction through layered wall materials

entries.title: Lava flow cooling into rock
entries.description: A glowing orange lava stream flowing down a gentle slope, cooling and darkening to gray rock as it moves, with steam-like white particles rising where temperature drops rapidly and labels marking “hot,” “warm,” and “solidified” zones.

entries.title: Thermal imaging of a walking figure
entries.description: A simple humanoid figure walking across a light floor while an overhead “thermal camera” plane scans and projects a false-color temperature map onto the figure’s surface, shifting from cool blues to warm reds at joints and torso.

entries.title: Convection currents in a heated fluid box
entries.description: A transparent rectangular container filled with many tiny spheres representing fluid; the bottom is heated red, top cooled blue, and particles near the bottom rise while cooler particles sink, forming visible circulating convection loops.
